description: This is a CMake module script designed to locate and configure the Broadcom Nexus library within a build system. It defines whether the Nexus library is available, sets up imported targets, and manages dependencies and configurations based on the presence of related libraries and files.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the specified header file 'nexus_config.h' within the given path suffixes.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the specified library files such as 'nexus', 'b_os', 'nexus_client', and 'nxclient'.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes additional CMake modules, such as 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs'.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard arguments for package configuration, ensuring required components are found.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks certain variables as advanced to hide them from normal user interfaces.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an imported library target 'NEXUS::NEXUS' with specific properties.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for targets, such as include directories, link libraries, and compile definitions.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs status messages during the configuration process.
